integrity: Exact finite-dimensional analytic proof accompanies the claim. The standalone computational checker is diagnostic. Originality assessment is subject to unindexed equivalent calculations.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected unweighted cycles with at least five vertices, graph-distance Lipschitz seminorm, and unnormalized combinatorial Laplacian; no claim for conductance-weighted cycles, arbitrary graphs, or a uniform-in-dimension small-time limit.
title: Exact graph-heat Lipschitz norms on cycles and a four-class short-time law
